name: Shree Krishna Paper Mills & Industries Ltd

facts.business: Shree Krishna Paper Mills & Industries Ltd. manufactures and sells paper products.
key_risks: Revenue recognition complexities due to variable considerations like discounts, rebates, and returns
Contingent liabilities and commitments requiring significant management judgment
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013, and details have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by applicable Indian Accounting Standards. Unsecured loans from related parties amount to Rs 1.53 lakhs as at March 31, 2026. Material related party transactions with Gopala Sales Private Limited are proposed for approval.
